card.name: Ending "-ed" after Ring and Box
card.fires_on: The ending "ed" attached to a noun like Ring or Box (ringed, Boxed Warning). It also fires weakly on small words such as "of" after all or whole, and "with" after a drug name.

modes.label: -ed after Ring/Box
modes.description: The ending "ed" completes ringed or Boxed right after the noun.

modes.label: of after all/whole
modes.description: The small word "of" follows all or whole before a noun.
modes.example: it is more convenient to consider the whole<< of>> the third ventricle

modes.label: with after drug name
modes.description: The word "with" in a dosing instruction about food.
modes.example: Take BRAFTOVI<< with>> or without food.

card.plain: It fires when a word like ringed or Boxed is being finished, and sometimes on a small linking word like "of".
